title: Construction Safety Sentinel Configuration Schema
description: Complete configuration schema for the Sentinel safety monitoring system

_demo_mode.description: Optional demo mode indicator (ignored by parser)

streams.description: Array of video stream configurations (can be empty during initial setup)

type.description: Stream source type (rtsp, usb camera, http stream)

uri.description: Stream URI (RTSP URL, USB device path, or HTTP URL)

zones.description: Safety zones to monitor within this stream

id.description: Unique zone identifier (numeric, can be string for compatibility)

polygon_type.description: Type of geometric area (rectangle or polygon)

points.description: Polygon vertices as [x, y] coordinates (min 3 for triangle)

model_path.description: Path to YOLO model file (ONNX format)

database_path.description: Path to SQLite database for storing violations

alert_cooldown.description: Minimum milliseconds between alerts for same zone+person (1-300 seconds)

inference_interval.description: Process every Nth frame (1=every frame, 2=every 2nd, etc.) for performance tuning

log_retention_days.description: Retain violation logs for N days before auto-cleanup

stream_port.description: HTTP port for MJPEG stream output

detection_tuning.description: YOLO detection parameter tuning (computer vision edge case handling)

confidence_threshold.description: Minimum confidence for detection (lower = more detections, higher recall for safety, but more false positives)

nms_threshold.description: Non-Maximum Suppression threshold for duplicate box removal (lower = stricter filtering)

inference_interval.description: Process every Nth frame (1=every frame, 2=every 2nd, etc.)

tracking_tuning.description: SORT tracker and Kalman filter parameter tuning (occlusion robustness)

max_age.description: Max frames to keep track alive without detection (45 frames @ 25 FPS = 1.8 seconds for occlusion tolerance)

min_hits.description: Minimum detections before track is considered confirmed

iou_threshold.description: Intersection-over-Union threshold for associating detections to tracks

feature_threshold.description: Minimum feature similarity (color histogram) for Re-ID matching

occlusion_extension_frames.description: Additional frames to extend track lifetime when occlusion is detected (people hidden by obstacles)

preprocessing.description: Image preprocessing for extreme lighting conditions (CLAHE: Contrast-Limited Adaptive Histogram Equalization)

clahe_enabled.description: Enable CLAHE preprocessing for glare/darkness robustness

clahe_clip_limit.description: CLAHE contrast amplification (higher = more aggressive correction, 1.0-4.0 typical)

clahe_tile_size.description: CLAHE tile grid size (affects local vs global correction; 8x8 typical)

clahe_blur_kernel.description: Gaussian blur kernel for reducing CLAHE tile artifacts (odd numbers only)

zone_detection.description: Zone boundary detection tuning (perspective error handling)

mode.description: Detection mode: 'point' (single point), 'footprint' (bottom box edge), 'calibrated' (uses spatial mapper if available)

boundary_margin.description: Pixel margin at zone boundary (-5=strict, 0=exact, +5=forgiving; handles bounding box detection errors)

footprint_voting.description: Voting strategy for footprint points: 'all'=all points in zone, 'majority'=2/3 in zone, 'any'=any point in zone

mqtt.description: MQTT broker configuration for event publishing

host.description: MQTT broker hostname or IP address

topic.description: MQTT base topic for publishing events (use v1 for version compatibility)

client_id.description: MQTT client identifier (should be unique per instance)
